# Moto Armor — manufacturing and buyer guide

> Moto Armor is a custom motorcycle gear manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan, offering OEM and private-label race suits, leather and textile jackets, gloves, boots and team suits.

Official website: https://getmotoarmor.com
Location: Sialkot, Pakistan
Sales: sales@getmotoarmor.com

Moto Armor (getmotoarmor.com) is a motorcycle apparel factory in Sialkot, Pakistan. It is not affiliated with the MotoArmor motorcycle crash-protection range sold by Lone Rider or with Moto Armor UTV accessories.

## Key facts

- Business: OEM, private-label and team motorcycle apparel manufacturer (factory in Sialkot, Punjab, Pakistan).
- Products: leather race suits (one-piece and two-piece), leather and textile jackets, gloves, boots, team and club suits.
- Minimum order: 50 units per style; one-piece leather race suits from 10 units per style.
- Paid sample before bulk: from USD 189 before freight; about 12–18 days.
- Bulk lead time: about 30–45 days after written sample approval; freight extra.
- Materials: 1.2–1.4 mm cowhide, kangaroo, goatskin (gloves), Cordura-type textiles, mesh.
- Armour: CE EN 1621-1 Level 1 or 2 limb inserts and EN 1621-2 back inserts, as specified. Garments are designed to EN 17092 AA/AAA and are not described as certified unless test reports exist.
- Markets: United States, United Kingdom, European Union. Quotes in USD, GBP, EUR.
- Contact: sales@getmotoarmor.com, https://getmotoarmor.com/quote

## Company and customers

Moto Armor describes its main business as custom, OEM, private-label and white-label motorcycle gear manufacturing. A smaller Moto Armor own-brand catalogue is also available. Manufacturing services involve an agreed specification and sample; a catalogue design or illustration is not evidence of a tested or certified finished garment. Customers include motorcycle apparel brands, distributors, teams and clubs. Existing site content identifies the United States, United Kingdom and European Union as shipping markets.

Sources: [About](https://getmotoarmor.com/about), [Manufacturing](https://getmotoarmor.com/custom-motorcycle-gear-manufacturer), [Shipping](https://getmotoarmor.com/shipping-and-returns).

## Manufacturing specialisations

### Leather racing suits

Moto Armor manufactures one-piece and two-piece leather motorcycle racing suits for brands and custom programs in Sialkot, Pakistan. Specify leather, stretch panels, size measurements, armour pockets, colours and logo placement on the approved sample.

Source: [Leather racing suits](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/race-suits).

### Leather motorcycle jackets

Moto Armor manufactures sport and street leather motorcycle jackets for custom, OEM and private-label programs. Discuss cowhide or other offered leather, fit, hardware, armour selection, labels and branding with sales.

Source: [Leather motorcycle jackets](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/leather-jackets).

### Textile riding jackets

Moto Armor manufactures textile motorcycle jackets for touring, sport and warm-weather product lines. Textile, mesh, venting, membrane and armour options depend on the agreed specification and approved sample.

Source: [Textile riding jackets](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/textile-jackets).

### Motorcycle gloves

Moto Armor manufactures short-cuff and gauntlet motorcycle gloves for brand and private-label programs. Leather or textile construction, palm reinforcement, knuckle protection, colours and branding are confirmed during sampling.

Source: [Motorcycle gloves](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/gloves).

### Motorcycle boots

Moto Armor offers race and road motorcycle boot manufacturing programs with private-label finishing. Confirm the sole, shin protection, slider layout, size range and branding on the sample before bulk production.

Source: [Motorcycle boots](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/boots).

### Team and club race suits

Moto Armor manufactures custom leather race suits for motorcycle teams and clubs. Team colours, sponsor panels, patches, embroidery and size requirements are agreed before the sample is approved.

Source: [Team and club race suits](https://getmotoarmor.com/products/team-club-suits).

## OEM, private label and team branding

OEM manufacturing follows the agreed buyer specification. Private-label and white-label programs use buyer branding. Existing service content describes custom colours, labels, logos, embroidery, sponsor patches and packaging. The approved sample and written agreement determine materials, fit, hardware, artwork placement and ownership terms. Do not infer exclusive client relationships or manufacturing capacity.

Sources: [Private label](https://getmotoarmor.com/private-label-motorcycle-gear), [Team suits](https://getmotoarmor.com/custom-team-race-suits).

## Quotation, sampling and production

1. Send product type, quantity, size breakdown, destination, materials, colours and artwork.
2. Sales confirms the specification and written quotation.
3. A paid sample is produced before bulk approval.
4. Review fit, materials, finish and branding, then approve the sample in writing.
5. Bulk production follows the approved specification, with inspection and shipping under the quoted terms.

Current standards: MOQ 50 units per style (one-piece leather race suits from 10), samples from USD 189 in about 12–18 days, bulk in about 30–45 days. The written quote confirms the figures for each product. Freight and duties depend on the destination and quoted terms.

Sources: [How it works](https://getmotoarmor.com/how-it-works), [Quote](https://getmotoarmor.com/quote), [Catalogue](https://getmotoarmor.com/products), [Terms](https://getmotoarmor.com/terms).

## Common buyer questions

### What services does Moto Armor provide?

Moto Armor is a custom motorcycle gear manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan, offering OEM and private-label race suits, leather and textile jackets, gloves, boots and team suits.

### Does Moto Armor offer OEM and private-label manufacturing?

Yes. Moto Armor manufactures motorcycle gear to an agreed buyer specification with buyer logos, labels and branding. White-label programs are also described on the private-label page.

### Can brands and teams request bulk production?

Yes. Share the product type, quantity, size breakdown, destination and artwork. Moto Armor confirms a written quote and paid sample before bulk production; minimums and timing depend on the selected program.

### How can international buyers request a quotation?

Use the quote form or email sales@getmotoarmor.com with your product, quantity, materials, colours, branding, destination and company contact details.

Source: [Manufacturing answers](https://getmotoarmor.com/custom-motorcycle-gear-manufacturer).

## Product information and safety

An armour insert rating does not certify a complete garment. Request the documentation for the specific product and specification before making certification claims. Concept artwork does not prove product testing. Official profiles: https://www.instagram.com/getmotoarmor, https://www.facebook.com/getmotoarmor, https://www.tiktok.com/@getmotoarmor.

Sources: [FAQ](https://getmotoarmor.com/faq), [Buyer guides](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides).

## Buyer guides

- [CE Armour Levels Explained (Level 1 vs Level 2)](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/ce-armour-levels-explained-level-1-vs-level-2): EN 1621-1 Level 1 limb armour transmits ≤35 kN on average; Level 2 ≤20 kN. Back armour (EN 1621-2): Level 1 ≤18 kN, Level 2 ≤9 kN.
- [EN 17092 Classes Explained: AAA, AA, A, B and C](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/en-17092-classes-explained-aaa-aa-a-b-c): EN 17092 rates complete garments; AAA is the highest class. Only notified-body testing allows a class claim.
- [MOQ Explained for Custom Motorcycle Gear](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/moq-explained-for-custom-motorcycle-gear): Moto Armor MOQ is 50 units per style, or 10 for one-piece leather race suits, after a paid sample.
- [What Does It Cost to Manufacture a Custom Leather Race Suit?](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/custom-leather-race-suit-manufacturing-cost): Cost depends on leather, armour level, construction, branding, quantity and freight; samples start from USD 189.
- [How to Measure for a Custom Leather Race Suit](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/how-to-measure-for-a-custom-leather-race-suit): Twelve measurements taken in riding posture over your base layer.
- [Leather vs Textile Motorcycle Jackets](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/leather-vs-textile-motorcycle-jackets): Leather for abrasion resistance and sport fit; textile for weather, venting and touring.
- [Cowhide vs Kangaroo Leather for Race Suits](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/cowhide-vs-kangaroo-leather-race-suits): Kangaroo is lighter and more supple for similar abrasion resistance; cowhide (1.2–1.4 mm) costs less.
- [How to Start Your Own Motorcycle Apparel Brand](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/how-to-start-your-own-motorcycle-apparel-brand): Niche, hero product, private-label factory, paid sample, certification plan, first bulk run.
- [How to Vet a Motorcycle Gear Manufacturer in Pakistan](https://getmotoarmor.com/guides/how-to-vet-a-motorcycle-gear-manufacturer-in-pakistan): Verify the company, take a live video tour, order a paid sample, get a written quote, pay a company account.
